footprints.description: NKK FS series DPDT high-frequency slide switch, straight PC pins, 2 x 3 pins 4.0 x 3.5 mm, 4 mounting holes
footprints.note: FS.pdf p.3 (H16) Typical Switch Dimensions, PCB layout at the right of FS22ABP: 6 terminal holes 0.8 dia on 4.0 mm columns (pins 4-6 left, 1-3 right, pin 1 top-right) and 3.5 mm rows, two 1.2 dia holes on the centre line at +-1.75 mm, two 1.6 dia holes on the centre line at +-7.85 mm from the middle row (the four unnumbered holes are mounting posts/ground legs, drawn as plated pin-0 pads; the drawing does not say plated or not). Drawn as the PCB layout (top view); origin = the middle of the hole pattern, taken as the body centre. Pad = drill + 0.6. Body 7.4 x 17.0 from the part-outline view (.291 x .669).

footprints.description: NKK M series (MSN) single-pole slide switch, right-angle PC terminal 30 with bracket, 3 pins 4.7 mm apart
footprints.note: MSN_SlidesNonillum_DP.pdf p.7 (H36) MSN12ASG30 PCB layout: 3 holes 1.8 dia in a row 4.7 mm apart (pin 3 left, 1 right), 2 bracket-leg holes 1.5 dia 6.6 mm apart on the centre line 9.53 mm in front of the pin row (unnumbered pin-0 pads). Top view of the board; the end view numbers 1 2 3 left to right as seen from the terminal side, which is the mirror. Origin = body centre: body 13.2 wide (.520) x 6.4 deep (the body depth .252 of the straight-terminal drawing; the 30 side view agrees), front taken 0.5 mm in front of the bracket legs, so the bent terminals lie behind the body. Pad = drill + 0.6 (bracket pad 2.1). The vertical position of the origin along the depth is an estimate from the side view.

footprints.description: NKK SS3 series SPDT side-actuated SMT slide switch, gull-wing terminals 2.0 mm apart, 2 mounting pads
footprints.note: SS3surfaceMount.pdf p.4 (H56) TERMINAL SPACING A, SS312 land pattern: 3 signal pads 2.55 x 1.0 mm (the 1.0 mm gap Typ between pads, 2.0 mm pitch), two 1.7 x 1.7 mm mounting pads 9.8 mm apart, overall 5.6 mm from the mounting pads' outer edge to the signal pads' outer edge; the gap between mounting and signal pads (1.35 mm) is derived 5.6 - 1.7 - 2.55. Top view of the board (PC land drawing), pin 1 at the bottom as drawn. Body 4.0 x 9.2 mm (p.4 (H56) 3D drawing, p.5 (H57)). Assumption (the drawing gives no body outline against the land): body centred on the origin, signal pad outer edge flush with the gull-wing tip 1.4 mm outside the body (x = 3.4), so the mounting pads sit at x = -1.35 under the body's end tabs. Pin 3, 2, 1 top to bottom.
